title: A protocol for the generation of EPO - Producing neural crest cells from human induced pluripotent stem cells
author: Lavecchia, Buttò, et al.

steps.title: Differentiate hiPSCs to NCCs
steps.instruction: Culture human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSCs) in Basal Medium supplemented with freshly prepared 5 mM lithium chloride for eight consecutive days to induce differentiation into neural crest cells (NCCs).

steps.title: Expose NCCs to oxygen conditions
steps.instruction: After the 8‑day differentiation, transfer the NCCs to fresh Basal Medium and incubate them under either normoxic (ambient) or hypoxic conditions for either 48 hours or 72 hours to evaluate functional EPO production.
